settlement_source: CF Benchmarks CME CF Ether-Dollar Real Time Index (ETHUSD_RTI; Kalshi calls it 'ERTI'), https://www.cfbenchmarks.com/data/indices/ETHUSD_RTI ; terms https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/ETH.pdf (template with placeholders). Constituents: Bitstamp, Kraken, Gemini, Coinbase, LMAX Digital, Crypto.com, Bullish. Order-book index, depth parameter 1%, calc 200 ms, disseminated 1/s at 0.01.
settlement_variable: Simple average of 60 per-second ETHUSD_RTI values in the minute before T; YES iff average > X.99 strike (strict). custom_strike.round_digits='2' suggests the average is rounded to 2 dp (mode unknown). No data -> NO.
timezone: US Eastern wall-clock with EDT/EST label; API close_time UTC. Fall-back-hour behaviour unknown.
tie_handling: Strict > X.99; mean of 3059.995 would be YES though below '$3,060'. 'Between' variants inclusive.
rounding: RTI 0.01; round_digits=2 for expiration value; rounding mode and whether applied before comparison unknown.
trading_close_vs_settlement: close_time == T; trading open through the whole averaging window. settlement_timer 60 s; expected_expiration close+5 min; expiration_time close+7 d backstop. No preliminary value published.
early_close_or_void_clauses: can_close_early true, no condition. No data -> NO (no void). Market Outcome Review 6.3(c), delay 7.1. $25k accountability. ETH hard-fork policy applies to the index.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Generic 'Ethereum price' vs CF order-book index only
Data outage -> NO not disclosed in title
Contract PDF is an unfilled template; operative wording only in per-market rules

toxicity_flags: Settlement window (T-60s..T) lies entirely inside live trading: anyone streaming the index can compute the running 60-s average; resting orders near the strike in the last minute are adversely selected
Settlement is a 60-s TWAP of an order-book index, not the spot/last-trade print; Coinbase/Binance tickers are proxies only
Kalshi does not publish the computed average for BTC (settlement_value null); rounding/boundary cases cannot be audited
Rounding/precision and window boundary (1-s vs 200-ms samples, inclusive/exclusive) unspecified
No data at expiration -> resolves NO (not void)
Kalshi Market Outcome Review (Rule 6.3) and settlement delay (Rule 7.1) at sole discretion
CF Benchmarks is Kraken-owned (Payward); Kraken is a constituent; Expert Judgement permitted in extraordinary circumstances
Constituent set and methodology changed Jun-Sep 2026 (uncrossing, dynamic spacing, 200 ms effective time)
EDT/EST label changes with DST (Nov 1 2026); UTC close_time authoritative
